title: What SEED's copy step reads
objective: COPY-READ-20261118-001's referee found every copy step in one closure class, with about 55 refused fills per absorbing one; the coordinator asked what separates them inside it. By MID-RULE E1 every new crossing joins a split separating one end pair to a split separating the other, so SEED's verdict can be read on those splits and the crossers of a model split. Test a frozen local rule (model among the splits of the end pair that shares a distinction with the middle pair) as a classifier against SEED on every crossing-making fill, with the refusals broken down, from bracketings of 5 to 8 and lines of 12. Serves G1 and G16; challenges A101.
stop_rule: One proof and one frozen computation with its read-out; referee hand-off; report.
